In contrast, VOC remains essentially independent of Rseries throughout the investigated range because no net current flows under open-circuit conditions, eliminating any voltage drop across the series resistance.

However, as Rshunt decreases below 103 Ω⋅cm2, the influence of Rseries becomes increasingly apparent.
